ceo.notes: Identity is well confirmed by full name, company, role and prior-employer chain. The 2024 local annual report confirms CEO status but withholds detailed management biographies under Government Resolution No. 1102. Education has a conflict: Lenta's 2021 issuer report states HSE in 2006 with economist diploma in Finance and Credit, while X5/Magnit/Retail sources often state 2005 and Interfax states an HSE program in Stock Market and Investments; the JSON uses the more specific Lenta 2021 issuer wording. APABANK board service is kept as a weaker auxiliary-sourced fact. No confirmed academic degree, research profile, publications, patents or h-index were found for the target person; similarly named scientific and literary profiles were rejected as namesakes. ROUND 2 (gap-filling + GICS + qualification_degree + institution normalization, this session): (1) Local filings re-scanned in full (both MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/LENT PDFs, full-text extracted) for 'Сорокин', 'торгово-экономич', 'АПАБАНК', 'Высшая школа экономики', 'инженер-технолог' -- only the already-known single CEO-message signature hit was found, confirming no additional local biography exists (management biographies are withheld under Government Resolution No. 1102, as already noted). (2) The only genuine null gap in this person's record was education[0].program_or_specialty; it was filled using retail.ru and newprospect.ru, which independently state the same fuller specialty wording ('инженер-технолог общественного питания', 'повар 5-го разряда', faculty of food industry) beyond the primary issuer report's short 'инженер-технолог'. (3) A new primary-source corroboration for the previously weak APABANK board-membership fact was found: the bank's own official site (archived via Wayback Machine, web.archive.org/web/20171012230338/apabank.com/about/board/) lists Sorokin as a current Board member with a matching short bio; this upgrades APABANK from a retail.ru/TAdviser-only auxiliary fact to one independently corroborated by the organization's own official source, though the exact 2010-2015 start/end years still rely on retail.ru/TAdviser (the archived page itself carries no explicit join/leave date). (4) sector/industry_group/industry were added at company level (Consumer Staples / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name), matching Lenta's core hypermarket/supermarket grocery-retail business) and to all 12 professional_experience entries, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json; each organization was classified by its own primary business, not by any shared group: Gillette as Consumer Staples/Household & Personal Products/Personal Care Products (New Name) (razors/grooming, not cleaning products); Sun Interbrew as Consumer Staples/Food, Beverage & Tobacco/Beverages (brewer); AlfaStrakhovanie and AlfaStrakhovanie-Life as Financials/Insurance/Insurance; OJSC Masshtab as Real Estate/Real Estate Management & Development (New)/Real Estate Management & Development (New Code) (confirmed via a targeted web check this round as a residential/commercial real-estate development holding, not a retailer); APABANK as Financials/Banks/Banks; X5/Pyaterochka, Perekrestok, Tander/Magnit, Lenta PLC, LLC Lenta and MKPAO Lenta all as Consumer Staples/Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name)/Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name) (grocery retail chains). No entry required an all-null GICS triple this round -- every organization's primary line of business was identifiable with reasonable confidence. (5) qualification_degree was added to both education[] entries using only the ten allowed values: 'Specialist degree' for the 1994 St Petersburg institute engineer-technologist qualification and for the 2006 HSE economist/Finance-and-Credit qualification, consistent with the pre-Bologna single-tier five-year Soviet/Russian higher-education structure and with the same qualification-to-degree mapping already used elsewhere in this dataset (e.g. KAZT's 'инженер-технолог' entries, and the 'экономист' mapping used across AFKS/AQUA/BELU/EUTR/DVEC). degrees[] remains empty; no confirmed separate academic degree was found this round either, so nothing required a qualification_degree there. (6) Both institution fields were normalized to their canonical university_names.json form: 'Санкт-Петербургский торгово-экономический институт' -> 'Санкт-Петербургский торгово-экономический университет' (canonical entry already lists the institute-era name as an alias); 'Государственный университет - Высшая школа экономики, Москва' -> 'Национальный исследовательский университет «Высшая школа экономики»' (canonical entry already lists this exact raw string as an alias). Both raw strings were already present as exact aliases in university_names.json, so new_institutions_found for this ticker is an empty list; the APABANK archived page's own variant wording ('Санкт-Петербургский институт советской торговли') was not adopted as the institution field value because it is a less-precise/older name for the same already-catalogued institution and the issuer-report wording remains preferred, per round 1's resolution. No previously confirmed fact was deleted or overwritten; only additions (program_or_specialty, qualification_degree, GICS fields, one new corroborating source) and the two institution-string normalizations above were made, cross-checked against the pre-round-2 backup (output/LENT_person_info.json.bak_round2) to confirm zero unintended removals. QUALITY-PASS ROUND (2026-07-30): Before this round's edits, the on-disk working copy of this file had regressed to a pre-Round-2 state (education[0].program_or_specialty null again, institution names un-normalized, no new_institutions_found key, APABANK entry reverted to the media-only description) even though Round 2's fixes above were already committed to git -- an intervening process appears to have overwritten the file from a stale copy, the exact failure mode this pass is meant to guard against. This round restored the committed Round-2 content rather than re-deriving it from scratch, and additionally: (a) fully applied the APABANK archive.org upgrade to the professional_experience entry itself (description and source), which Round 2's own notes had described but had not actually written into that entry; (b) sanity-checked all 12 professional_experience GICS triples against gics_taxonomy.json -- all are exact-row matches and business-plausible (e.g. Masshtab as Real Estate Management & Development, not Financials; both AlfaStrakhovanie entities as Insurance, not Consumer Finance); none required correction; (c) ran additional targeted research on the still-open HSE year/program conflict -- a new source, whoiswho.dp.ru, independently corroborates the 'Stock Market and Investments' program wording (matching Interfax 2020) but states no year, so it does not resolve the 2005-vs-2006 year question; the Lenta 2021 issuer-report value (2006, Finance and Credit) is kept as the more reliable primary source and the conflict remains explicitly unresolved and documented, not silently picked; (d) ran a bounded fresh-query check (MBA/candidate-of-sciences, rusprofile.ru director-registry profile, Russian Presidential management-training programme, LinkedIn) for an additional academic degree beyond the base specialist diploma -- found nothing new, confirming degrees[] is correctly empty.

validation_notes: Processed 1 person from CSV for LENT. Checked 2 local LENT documents: 2024 annual report and 2024 summary consolidated financial statements. Completed 1 research round containing local review plus two web search passes and more than 25 distinct queries. Education was found, but the HSE year/program wording differs across sources; the direct Lenta 2021 issuer report was preferred and the conflict is noted. No people besides Sorokin were added because the CSV contains no other LENT people and the 2024 annual report does not disclose Board member names. Weak sources were used only for APABANK board membership. No confirmed research experience, publications, patents or h-index were found. Namesakes excluded: writer Vladimir Georgievich Sorokin and unrelated academic/research profiles with the same first and last name. Search is considered complete because local documents were checked first, official issuer/prior-employer sources were reviewed, previous employers were followed, education and scientific checks were separate, and the second web pass produced no new higher-quality facts. ROUND 2 (gap-filling + GICS taxonomy + qualification_degree + institution normalization, per REFINEMENT.md, this session): Re-scanned both local LENT filings in full text -- no new biographical hits beyond the already-known CEO-message signature (management biographies remain withheld under Government Resolution No. 1102). Filled the one genuine null gap on the CEO (education[0].program_or_specialty) using retail.ru and newprospect.ru, both already cited elsewhere in this file, which independently state the fuller specialty wording beyond the primary issuer report's short qualification. Found one new primary corroborating source for the previously weak APABANK board-membership fact (the bank's own archived official website, via Wayback Machine), added to both ceo.sources and the top-level sources list; this does not change any field value, only strengthens an already-recorded fact. Added company-level sector/industry_group/industry (Consumer Staples / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name)) and the same three GICS fields to all 12 professional_experience entries for the CEO, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json and classified by each organization's own primary business (grocery retail for the X5/Perekrestok/Magnit/Lenta chain of employers; Insurance for AlfaStrakhovanie entities; Banks for APABANK; Real Estate Management & Development for OJSC Masshtab, confirmed via a targeted web check this round; Beverages for Sun Interbrew; Personal Care Products for Gillette). No organization required an all-null GICS triple. Added qualification_degree to both education[] entries ('Specialist degree' for both, consistent with the pre-Bologna Soviet/Russian single-tier higher-education structure and with the same mapping already used for identical qualification wordings elsewhere in this dataset); degrees[] remains empty and required no qualification_degree additions. Normalized both institution fields to their canonical university_names.json form (both raw strings were already listed there as exact aliases, so new_institutions_found for LENT is an empty list -- no institution outside the reference file was encountered). tmt[] remains empty; this ticker still has only one CSV-listed person (the CEO) and the 2024 local annual report still does not disclose Board of Directors member names, so no new people were added, consistent with round 1's finding. No previously confirmed fact was deleted, overwritten, or altered beyond straight additions and the two institution-string normalizations; verified against a pre-round-2 backup (output/LENT_person_info.json.bak_round2) with zero unintended removals. QUALITY-PASS ROUND (2026-07-30): Discovered the working file had silently regressed from the git-committed Round-2 state to a pre-Round-2 state (missing new_institutions_found, program_or_specialty null, institutions un-normalized, APABANK entry reverted) -- restored from the committed Round-2 record instead of re-deriving values, and fully applied the APABANK archive.org source upgrade to the professional_experience entry itself (Round 2's notes described this upgrade but had not written it into that entry). Sanity-checked all 12 professional_experience GICS triples against gics_taxonomy.json; all were already exact-row matches and business-plausible, none required correction. Ran additional targeted research on the still-unresolved HSE education year/program conflict: found and added one new corroborating source (whoiswho.dp.ru) for the 'Stock Market and Investments' program wording, but it gives no year and does not resolve the 2005-vs-2006 conflict, so the Lenta 2021 issuer-report value is kept and the conflict remains explicitly documented as open. Ran one bounded fresh-query check (4 new queries) for an additional academic degree beyond the base specialist diploma; found nothing new.
